challenge.method: Compare the OnOff? grammar with explicit Off, a bare statement and a missing statement. Compile three otherwise identical late-binding examples using Roslyn vbc 4.14.0-3.25279.5 (995f12b6) with /optionstrict-.
challenge.results: The pinned grammar makes the argument optional. The bare statement produced BC30574 for late binding, while the omitted statement and explicit Off compiled. These observations agree with the pinned rule for the tested compilation setting.

limitations: Pinned Visual Basic for .NET specification. A particular environment can choose its own setting when the file has no directive.
